ko.executive_summary: MediaTek is advancing smartphone SoCs with Dimensity 9600 Pro at 2nm node, while onsemi targets a $6 billion Physical AI opportunity by 2030. Samsung Foundry achieved 60% yield on 2nm but reports higher power consumption than Snapdragon competitors.
key_facts: onsemi $6 billion Physical AI target by 2030
BOS Semiconductors joined Arm Physical AI Ecosystem
Hyundai Mobis supporting automotive chip localization and SDV transition

implications.text: MediaTek and Samsung both deploying 2nm for mobile SoCs; power efficiency gap vs Snapdragon suggests process maturation still underway.
onsemi and ARM ecosystem partners positioning for embedded AI in devices; significant revenue stream emerging by end of decade.
Hyundai Mobis push for domestic automotive chip sourcing indicates regional sovereignty concerns driving diversification from traditional vendors.

ko.counterpoint: Samsung's 60% 2nm yield and power overhead vs. competitors suggests process window challenges may delay mass production ramp and competitive positioning.
